items.title: He Retired From Ford, Then Eyed Its $30,000 Electric Pickup. His Retiree Discount Suddenly Looked Uncomfortably Like Pay.
items.summary: A retired Ford assembly worker spotted the company's new electric pickup and remembered his retiree discount, then a familiar worry crept in: could saving money at a dealership cost him part of his Social Security check?

items.title: Fresh Tariffs Boost Domestic Steel, Dent Automakers
items.summary: Trade talks between the U.S. and Canada collapsed in the 11th hour Friday, renewing fears of an all-out trade war as new tariffs went into effect over the weekend. Ford and Stellantis shares slipped Monday after President Trump announced a 50% tariff on automobiles and auto parts from Canada come January.

items.title: U.S. and Canada Escalate Their Trade Fight. It Won’t Be the Last Tariff Tiff.
items.summary: Another trade war has started with a volley of tariff threats, and this time the fight is with America’s neighbor and closest trading partner, Canada.  While the U.S. has held several formal negotiations with Mexico this year about the USMCA, it hasn’t done so with Canada.

items.title: Carney Says US Wants to Destroy Canada Firms, Examines Retaliation Moves
items.summary: Prime Minister Mark Carney said his government is still working on options for retaliating against US President Donald Trump’s new tariffs on Canadian goods, but added that he’s willing to continue trade talks if the US adopts the “right attitude.”

items.title: Trump Wants to Protect U.S. Auto Makers. 2 Ways They Lose From New Tariffs.
items.summary: GM, Ford, and Stellantis shares were lower as trade talks between Canada and the U.S. broke down over the weekend.
